purpose: Read-only audit of existing YAIR consumers for the five proposed Streets of Rogue-inspired interaction directions; prevent duplicate implementation packets.

source_boundary.original_gameplay_source: UNAVAILABLE. No original Streets of Rogue gameplay logic is asserted or traced in this owner audit.
source_boundary.available_references: RogueLibs framework commit d76523acb484168f4d2d1d7bc0fce0d2c5d263f1 and redaphid mod commit 01f205c57f65ab98276c6989da6d98eddeb89c65 are private inputs reported by the research owner; framework/mod code is not original game logic or proof of game behavior.
source_boundary.delivery_state: Current YAIR feature families are documented implemented-unverified. This audit did not run tests, browser, save, build, or runtime checks.

decision.reason: The five directions already have concrete, integrated consumers in the current expansion/reference gameplay delivery. The requested audit found no additional small consumer that can be justified without duplicating the same player action/result loops. Broader content and human/playable acceptance remain separate from an owner-level gap.

coverage.direction: context, owner, consent-aware alternative interaction approaches
coverage.covered_by: The leaking-joint sequence offers ordinary brace versus learned matched seal, preserves a slower ordinary rack, and routes to paid kit delivery. Commands bind the actual target, co-location, owner, lender, consent, stock, knowledge, and costs. The sluice also admits a slower drainage route independently of battle.

evidence.finding: Current featureWaveContext composes the actual object/society/reference owners; actFeatureExpansion routes their actions through their hosts and persists the staged plan.

coverage.absence_search: Checked feature_objects and feature_battle command/action consumers and the main dispatch branches. These are already real competing routes; no second generic interaction menu or reskin packet is warranted.

coverage.direction: item combinations and target actions with useful aftereffects
coverage.covered_by: Actual log/sap/stamina/tool inputs create wet or sound staves, matched inserts and native kits. Knife condition changes, custody/deposit, NPC stock, knowledge, XP and persistent world joint phases are explicit. Cancellation refunds inputs; completion consumes or transforms the real item. Targeted delivery and repair also settle actual owner balances/items.
coverage.absence_search: Checked the concrete object recipes, host preview/commit and effects application for item, transfer, custody, world, relationship, and claim consumers. The actual transformation/aftermath seam exists.

coverage.direction: actor-owned abilities/statuses meaningful to NPC action choice
coverage.covered_by: NPCs have owned powers/sources and actual equipment/body/stamina. The fixed sluice actors select techniques and targets from their live gear, pressure, exposure and condition; paid cooling removes the pole pull option and adds guard behavior. Abilities require their actor's own source/mastery and resources. This is an authored local decision consumer, not a claim of general-purpose NPC AI.
coverage.absence_search: Checked featureNativeAction's live NPC candidate construction and gates, plus power/faculty/condition effect owners. A broader general controller authoring layer could be future work, but this direction already has the requested concrete consumer and does not justify a duplicate packet.

coverage.direction: environment operation with temporary status/change and residue
coverage.covered_by: The sluice gate/support has an objective, wedge, brace, escape and retained encounter result; the drying shelf joint has leaking/braced/sealed phases that alter later work time. The target change is saved in world/situation state, while materials, stamina, wounds, fatigue and receipts remain as aftermath.
coverage.absence_search: Checked object phase effects, native battle objective/effect settlement, and simulation boundaries for condition expiry. Persistent local residue and temporary conditions already have owners and consumers.

coverage.direction: finite optional conduct/objective tracking and retained consequences
coverage.covered_by: Optional feats require explicit enrollment, record completed approaches/method evidence, and track no-strike/prepared-team attempts with completed, violated, withdrawn and ordinary outcomes. Attempts are bounded and recognized only from committed receipts; the battle and conduct receipt retain spent costs and outcome.
coverage.absence_search: Checked the feat validator/advance logic, battle result settlement, and the actual main commit path. Recognition is attached to committed state, not merely UI visibility or enrollment.

live_callers.finding: Feature object, society, reference gameplay and native sluice commands are routed through concrete hosts; panels/hosts receive the shared current state, context and persistence callback.
Actual persistExpansion caller advances reference gameplay at 427, validates and stages the plan, then invokes persistExpansionPlan at 479 before publishing expansion state.
Preview, commit, frozen job/session, response, event and boundary APIs are actual owners called by the hosts, not unused exports.
Durable publication uses a staged transaction function; source audit only, no persistence behavior executed here.

current_delivery.finding: Current finite wave is explicitly implemented-unverified; schema9 optional enrollment and feature/legacy boundaries are documented. Gameplay/save/reload/failure/keyboard/director gates are deferred.

project_intent.finding: Expansion preserves a one-realm/one-prestige first milestone and broader systems; current owners already claim inventory, actor controllers, statuses, conditions, occurrence and persistence foundations.

snapshot.note: Read-only copies of cited source/document inputs as observed during the refresh. main.js had drifted since the prior audit; its citation now uses the live staged persistence boundary. Snapshot copies are chmod 0444.

limits: Source inputs were already moving/dirty. After parent review identified main.js drift, cited files were refreshed and copied to the private read-only snapshot path in integration_and_retention.snapshot. SHA-256 hashes identify observed contents.
No lines in this file establish Streets of Rogue mechanics. Original game source is unavailable; only supplied framework/mod context is qualified separately by the research owner.
No tests, browser, save/reload, build, runtime, commit, or follow-on delegation was performed.

consequential_review: Ordinary sleeve resin/kits/recharge need no learned power; only hook control requires acquired active mastery3.
Reference enrollment/conduct/recognition states and supporting live source/tool/condition admission were read directly.
Save/behavior/keyboard/director acceptance backlog is deferred and unrun.
coordinator_supplement.current_drift_policy: Use frozen observed snapshots for citations. Live shared writers can change unrelated code; no final bundle/version-parity claim is made.
